How: work the roadmap in this guide from stage 1 to stage 6 and tick each trophy off as it pops; the platinum unlocks itself at the end. Watch: nothing about the platinum itself can be missed, but it is gated by every missable on the watch list, so clear the four likely-missable trophies before the finale.
